role.title: OT Security Architect
role.description: DRAFT. OT specialization of NICE work role DD-WRL-001 (Cybersecurity Architecture). Designs the security architecture of OT environments: zones and conduits, the IT/OT boundary, remote access, monitoring and safety system independence, balancing security against availability and safety.
role.overlaps_method: Computed: NICE roles sharing the most statements with this role, excluding the roles it extends.

citations.note: Parent NICE role; all its statements are inherited.
Zones, conduits and target security levels.

open_questions: How much overlap with PR-OT-001 (OT Cybersecurity Engineer) is acceptable before the two should merge?
